props.heading: Getting to the harbour
props.address:
Harbour Summer School
The Boatshed, North Quay
Portlow PL12 3AB

map.alt: Boats moored along North Quay, beside the boatshed

props.directions:
The boatshed is a ten-minute walk from Portlow station. Follow the signs to the quay.
There's no parking on the quay, so please use the town car park on Station Road.
